system.description:
• Effect: A pool of Glamour points equal to your Intelligence modifier + half your Illusionist level (minimum 1), spent on tricks: any feature that costs Glamour.
  • You regain them all on a full rest.
  • You may use one trick on your turn, and Misdirect once a round out of turn.
  • Your illusions are your Illusion spells, your Phantasm and the doubles your tricks make.
  • 9th level: when an encounter begins and your pool is empty, you regain 2 points
